edits.text: 火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. The oracle-bone use has been tentatively linked to 火星; one interpretation identifies this as 大火, or 心宿二 (Antares), while the evidence does not specify the referent more precisely. The reason for the star’s name and any connection to literal ‘fire’ are unresolved.

This star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. The oracle-bone occurrence has been tentatively linked to 火星 and interpreted as 大火, or 心宿二 (Antares); the available evidence does not establish why the star was called 火 or a semantic connection with literal ‘fire’.
